image_description: An interior view of a rustic sawmill or lumber processing facility. The scene features heavy industrial machinery, specifically a large green bandsaw mechanism with levers and gears. A worker in dark clothing is visible on the left operating or standing near the machine. In the foreground right, a large vertical wooden post dominates the frame. Processed lumber planks are visible on the floor/table surface. The background shows structural beams and windows letting in natural light.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The bark texture on the large vertical post appears slightly smudged and lacks fine micro-detail, blending into the background in some areas, suggestive of AI generation smoothing.
The mechanical linkages and levers of the green saw mechanism appear physically ambiguous; connections seem to float or merge without clear pivot points or bolts, violating rigid body mechanics.
The human figure exhibits unnatural softness and edge bleeding into the background, lacking the sharp occlusion boundaries expected from a camera focus on the mid-ground.
